Today is 2026-06-21. I need CURRENT (June 2026), SOURCED catalyst/news research on three biotech stocks for a portfolio review. Use live web research (Firecrawl skill or web search) — do NOT rely on training data, which is stale. Every claim must have a source (URL + date).

Stocks (cost basis → price as of 2026-06-18 close):
1. PRAX (Praxis Precision Medicines) — avg cost $241.92 → $282.15 (+16.6%)
2. SYRE (Spyre Therapeutics) — $76.10 → $88.28 (+16.0%)
3. ALMS (Alumis) — $20.37 → $23.35 (+14.6%)

For EACH stock, return a concise structured block:
- Company / lead asset (confirm the ticker maps to the company I named; correct me if wrong)
- Next known catalyst + expected timing/window (clinical readout, FDA action, data presentation)
- What drove the stock over the last ~2 weeks (early-to-mid June 2026) — specific news or sector drift?
- Did the thesis materially improve, or did price just move?
- Any financing/dilution/offering flags
- Thesis-intact read: any sign the thesis broke?
- Main risk in the next 1-3 months
- Sources (URL + date for each key claim)

Rules: Report FACTS only — NO buy/sell/hold recommendations. If you can't verify something, say "unverified," don't guess. Be concise — this feeds a decision table.

- firecrawl: Search, scrape, and interact with the web via the Firecrawl CLI. Use this skill whenever the user wants to search the web, find articles, research a topic, look something up online, scrape a webpage, grab content from a URL, get data from a website, crawl documentation, download a site, or interact with pages that need clicks or logins. Also use when they say "fetch this page", "pull the content from", "get the page at https://", or reference external websites. This provides real-time web search with full page content and interact capabilities — beyond what Claude can do natively with built-in tools. Do NOT trigger for local file operations, git commands, deployments, or code editing tasks.
- firecrawl-agent: AI-powered autonomous data extraction that navigates complex sites and returns structured JSON. Use this skill when the user wants structured data from websites, needs to extract pricing tiers, product listings, directory entries, or any data as JSON with a schema. Triggers on "extract structured data", "get all the products", "pull pricing info", "extract as JSON", or when the user provides a JSON schema for website data. More powerful than simple scraping for multi-page structured extraction.

Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
